name: Inaugural Battle Royal

date.source: The show's own two-part posting date.

no_appearances_reason: The fifteen-man battle royal's own entrants and eliminations are narrated in the served text (part one introduces all fifteen by name; part two calls the finish) but not structurally parsed into characters.json, per the packet's own tier-1 ceiling -- a pending-enrichment note, per the tier rule and the holdings bar.
notes: The wing's only card: a fifteen-man battle royal for a bye into the second round of the HIWF World Championship Tournament. Entrants named on air: the Dark Knight, Killer Instinct, Jonney Gold, Ricky Johnson, Franky "Puerto Rican Ice" Delgado, Richie "Baby Taz" Delgado, the Stormtrooper of Death, Hellraiser, Blaze, Obscuridad (w/ manager Barnabas), Damon Oscar Avonoiaa ("DOA", w/ manager Vanessa Stone), Khan, the Megalomaniac and the Highlander. Hellraiser won, eliminating Franky Delgado last, earning the tournament bye; no second-round show survives.
